reason: Wrong vertical and wrong side of the market: 4DMT is a publicly traded (NASDAQ: FDMT, IPO 2020) late-stage clinical biotech developing AAV gene therapies — 172 employees, $702M raised, $756M market cap, HQ Emeryville CA — with zero relationship to David Shake's niche of $2M-$20M low-voltage systems integrators and electrical contractors adding managed Wi-Fi, surveillance, or access-control lines to buildings they already serve; all four matched postings (Director Clinical Operations - Lung Program, Associate Director Clinical Operations, R&D Informatics Analyst, Director FP&A) are clinical-trial and finance roles whose JD text is nothing but 4DMT's boilerplate agency notice and 4D-150/4D-710 pipeline description, so no live posting yields a quotable line redescribing the recurring-revenue or low-voltage-division pain Shake fixes, and a public company of this size is far too large for his fractional engagement model.
